description: Source file implementing utility functions for decoding IAMF (Immersive Audio Metadata Format) buffers, including parsing OBU headers, codec configs, audio elements, and mix presentations, with focus on binaural and surround audio configurations.

classes.name: BufferReader
classes.description: A utility class for reading various data types from a byte buffer, including support for Leb128 encoding, string reading, and byte skipping, used for parsing IAMF OBUs.

methods.name: ParseDescriptorOBU
methods.description: Parses a single IAMF OBU (Open Bitstream Unit) header and its content, updating the IamfBufferInfo structure accordingly.

methods.name: ParseCodecConfigOBU
methods.description: Parses a codec configuration OBU, extracting sample rate and number of samples, supporting Opus and ipcm codecs.

methods.name: CheckForAdvancedAudioElements
methods.description: Checks if an audio element contains binaural or surround configurations and updates corresponding IDs.

methods.name: ParseAudioElementOBU
methods.description: Parses an audio element OBU, extracting IDs and parameters, and identifying binaural or surround configurations.

methods.name: ParseMixPresentationOBU
methods.description: Parses a mix presentation OBU, determining the presentation ID based on preferences for binaural or surround audio.

methods.name: ParseInputBuffer
methods.description: Main function to parse an input buffer containing IAMF OBUs, filling an IamfBufferInfo structure with parsed data.
